primary_title: Astrocytic ET-1 System Determines Microglia Phenotype Following Spinal Cord Injury
decision_basis: The primary study reports that PAR1-pathway inhibition suppresses thrombin-induced astrocytic ET-1 precursor expression and identifies PAR1/RhoA/NF-kappaB and PAR1/MAPK/NF-kappaB as the bounded signaling routes.
limitations_preserved: Keep this as a pharmacology-supported pathway association in rat astrocytes; the study does not establish a direct PAR1-NF-kappaB physical complex or a terminal transcription-factor edge.
